text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police in the town of Kuito have discovered some 106 weapons including AK-47's, pistols and mortars.
- Twelve UNITA deputies and three ministers arrived in Luanda on Wednesday to eventually take up their places in a planned unity government.
- Gabonese planning minister Jean Ping met Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos and spoke about increased cooperation between the two countries.
